of maintenance performed on this type of
transformer.

DC

Use only
 fiberglass ladder.

Before starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer
 wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning. Collect it and send it to the dump.

Fix
 any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.

Oil
leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil and ground water and eventually on the eco-system. "It takes only I liter of Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to
render 1,000,000 liters of potable water useless for human consumption"

Safety
 helmet, safety shoes, and tool set

Complete
 tool kit/set, including a torque wrench,

Air
 blower, Lubricating
 grease (light grade),

Fine
 cloth for cleaning purposes,

Check entire
 transformer for oil leaks, special attention should be made to piping
 connections.
 Note: Oil
 leaks must be repaired as soon as possible, serious leaks immediately
 others on the next scheduled outage. Leaked oil is not only costly to
 replace, it is also harmful to the environment. Leaked oil must be cleaned
 up and properly disposed of, this process can also be costly

Check oil level
 gauge on the main tank to ensure level is in a safe operating range 
 (above minimum). Take into account the ambient temperature when
 making this inspection.

Check the oil
 level gauge on the tapchanger compartment; ensure it is also in the safe
 operating range (above minimum). Take into account the ambient temperature
 when making this inspection.

Check bushing
 oil levels via the sight glass on top of the bushings, it must be visible

Check the oil
 temperature gauge and record the maximum temperature degree rise
 as indicated by the drag hand reading on a Maintenance Record
 Data Sheet MRDS

Check the
 winding temperature gauge and record the maximum temperature degree rise as indicated by the drag hand reading) on a Maintenance
 Record Data Sheet MRDS

Check cooling
 fans to ensure they all operate properly and free of excess noise.
 Lubricate fans if necessary, i.e. on a yearly basis or if they are making
 excess noise.

Check the
 control wiring of the tapchanger, clean the tapchanger mechanism cabinet
 with an air blower, and then clean the controller contacts.

Check the
 control wiring of the transformer cooling, clean the transformer mechanism
 cabinet with an air blower, then clean/inspect the controller contacts,
 ensure breakers/fuses are in operating condition. Also check terminal
 strips for loose connections and check for signs of overheating

Check the
 condition of the air breather silica gel, it should be pink colour. If it
 has changed to a blue colour, it requires changing/drying. Check the oil
 level of the breather sump.

Clean the
 earthing resistor isolator, ensure the movable contacts are clean and
 apply a thin layer of grease. Also check the hinge joint of the isolator
 and apply a small amount of lubrication to ensure it moves freely.

Check the
 condition of the neutral point current transformer. Ensure it is not
 cracked or showing signs of over heating, also check the connections for
 tightness.

Using a torque
 wrench check that all electrical connections are properly tightened, take
 special care that bushing terminal clamps are torqued properly.
